description:
Aggregate the work that delivers this outcome: finalization is proven in repository state and every IssueStore backend runs one conformance suite.

## Background

This story groups the test-topology tasks that share one design surface, so they can be reviewed together once each has landed.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Mutation finalization is proven once, in the repository-state layer, and storage tests cover only the behaviour a backend adds.
- [hard] REQ-02: Both `IssueStore` backends run one shared reader and writer conformance suite, including path reads, decoding and commit-pinned reads, and backend tests cover only backend-specific behaviour.
title: Storage behaviour is proven once per contract
